What's your opinion? I'm looking forward to hearing your thoughts!

Best regards,
Li Hua}

Firstly, Beijing has promoted the use of shared bikes and expanded its bus and subway networks. These measures have greatly improved public transportation, encouraging people to use eco-friendly travel options instead of private cars, which helps reduce air pollution. Secondly, the city has increased its green spaces and water areas. This not only enhances the environment in the city center but also helps lower greenhouse gas emissions through the natural process of plants absorbing carbon dioxide. Green reflects both the visible changes in the cityscape and the growing awareness of environmental protection among its residents.

Yours,
Li Hua}
